root_cause: LinkedIn can reuse cached link-preview metadata for the same shared page URL across newly created posts, so correcting the page metadata alone does not guarantee a fresh preview.
prevention: When a cached social preview is materially wrong, use a fresh share URL path with its own og:url and explicit company-only social image.
Do not rely on query-string cache busting for the shared page URL.
The share URL may redirect humans to the canonical page after crawlers read the social metadata.
fix: Create /ai-modelwijzer-linkedin-2026 as a dedicated share URL with company-only Open Graph metadata and immediate human redirect to the canonical Modelwijzer.
